page_title: BET 3-1 RSO | Betis v Real Sociedad 19/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+4' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Pau Lopez comes off the line to clear the ball away.

90+2' Sofyan Amrabat (Betis) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.
90+2' Rough tackle by Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Betis earn a free kick.
90+1' The resulting set piece from Real Sociedad is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' The Real Sociedad players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
86' Here's the change. Giovani Lo Celso leaves the pitch and Rodrigo Riquelme (Betis) comes on as a substitute.
86' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad).
82' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
80' Betis enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
78' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
77' The Betis players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
75' It's time for a substitution. Aritz Elustondo (Real Sociedad) comes on in place of Jon Aramburu.
75' The linesman raises his flag. Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) is adjudged offside.
71' Today's referee Mateo Busquets rightly decides to book Duje Caleta-Car (Real Sociedad) for his harsh tackle.
71' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to make a change. Valentin Gomez (Betis) replaces Junior Firpo.
71' We are about to witness a substitution. Pablo Garcia (Betis) is replacing Antony.
70' Substitution. Pablo Fornals will be replaced by Marc Roca (Betis).
69' 3 - 1 Goal! Hector Bellerin shows great vision to find Pablo Fornals (Betis) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom right corner. 3:1.
67' Real Sociedad can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
67' Sergio Francisco decides to make a substitution. Pablo Marin will be replaced by Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad).
66' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) is coming onto the pitch as Takefusa Kubo cannot continue after picking up an injury.
66' Junior Firpo (Betis) is booked by the referee.
65' Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
62' The total number of attempts is 13:8.
60' Duje Caleta-Car (Real Sociedad) picks up a caution.
58' Here is a change. Jon Gorrotxategi is going off and Sergio Francisco gives the last tactical orders to Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad).
58' Substitution. Ander Barrenetxea makes way for Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad).
58' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.

57' Antony (Betis) is afforded space inside the box after collecting a pass, but the chance is wasted as his shot goes harmlessly over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.
54' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) picked up a yellow card from referee.
53' Betis quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
53' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) dribbles into space and finds himself in a shooting position, but his shot from the edge of the box is bravely blocked.

49' 2 - 1 Alex Remiro (Real Sociedad) attempts to head the ball away after a cross into the penalty area, but instead he accidentally sends it under the roof of his own goal. The goalkeeper was helpless.
49' A quickly taken corner by Betis.

47' Close! Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
46' That will be all from Diego Llorente who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Marc Bartra (Betis).
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' Mateo Busquets blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
41' Real Sociedad failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
39' The referee gives a yellow card to Natan (Betis).
39' Natan (Betis) brings his opponent down. Mateo Busquets has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
37' Real Sociedad fail to score from a corner as Pau Lopez (Betis) leaps to collect the ball.
34' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Sofyan Amrabat (Betis) receives a yellow card!
34' Jon Gorrotxategi (Real Sociedad) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Mateo Busquets blows his whistle for a foul.
30' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
26' Antony (Betis) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
26' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
24' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Real Sociedad.
19' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) has a go from distance but he can't find the target as it goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Sociedad.
18' Booking. Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) receives a caution from the referee.

18' Sofyan Amrabat (Betis) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball is out of play. Real Sociedad will have a throw-in.

13' 1 - 1 Stunning strike! Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) latches on to a precise through ball from Ander Barrenetxea before unleashing an unstoppable shot inside the left post from the edge of the area. Fantastic goal. The score is now 1:1.
12' Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) plays a through ball which would have led to a great opportunity, if it hadn't been stopped by the defence.
10' Real Sociedad are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
7' 1 - 0 Cucho Hernandez (Betis) produces a moment of pure magic and scores a spectacular goal by striking the ball into the top left corner of the net!
7' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) is awarded a yellow card.
6' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Real Sociedad, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
5' Mateo Busquets blows for a foul after Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Betis have a free kick.
4' Betis seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
